STEP 6. Check the harness wires between hood switch 
connector A-23 and ETACS-ECU connector C-112.
NOTE: After checking intermediate connector C-89, check the 
wires. If intermediate connector C-89 is damaged, repair or 
replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness Connector 
Inspection P.00E-2.
Q: Are the harness wires between hood switch connector 
A-23 and ETACS-ECU connector C-112 in good 
condition?
YES : Replace the ETACS-ECU. The input signal from the 
hood switch should be able to be checked and the 
theft-alarm system should be armed normally.
NO : Repair them. The input signal from the hood switch 
should be able to be checked and the theft-alarm 
system should be armed normally.
